decision.explanation: Gabriela Soto is described as representing both Penzance A.F.C. (a local association football club) and the Mexican cycling team Swapit-Agolico. The text explicitly states her role as a midfielder for Penzance A.F.C. in D1S6, and D2S2–D2S10 confirm her affiliation with Swapit-Agolico as of January 1st, 2023. 'Mexican cycling team' is a redundant description of Swapit-Agolico and not a distinct entity, so it is excluded.
